senses.gloss:
अर्ध अर्ध, i. e. ऋध् + अ.
 I. adj., f. धा. Half, halved, Lass. 22, 2.
 --Often former part of comp. words: -पण, Half a paṇa, Man. 8, 404. -अक्त, Half spoken, Pañc. 77, 2. -दगध, Half burnt, Pañc. 98, 1.
 --When before cardinal numerals it denotes:
 1. A half more, e. g. -त्रयोदशन्, thirteen and a half, Yājñ. 2, 265.
 2. A half of the following number more, e. g. -शत, hundred and fifty, Man. 8, 331.
 3. Division of the following number, [] -पञ्चाशत्, twenty-five, Man. 8, 268.
 --When an ordinal follows a half is added, e. g. -तृतीय, three and a half, Rām. 2, 92, 10.
 --When it follows a cardinal numeral, this numeral is divided, e. g. दशार्ध, i. e. दशन्-, Five, Man. 1, 24.
 II. n. A half, Man. 8, 296.
 III. m. A part, e. g. जघन-, the rear of an army, MBh. 5, 5162. पश्च-, The hind-part, Śāk. d. 7. पूर्व-, The former part, Bhartṛ. 2, 5.
 --Comp.

अर्धचन्द्र अर्ध-चन्द्र, m.
 1. A half-moon, Rām. 3, 49, 35.
 --Cf. अर्ध-भाषर.
 2. An arrow with a head like a half-moon, Rām. 3, 34, 30; cf. 6, 36, 77.
 3. The hand bent into a semicircle or the shape of a claw, as for the purpose of seizing or clutching any thing. अर्धचन्द्रं दा. To seize one by the neck, Pañc. 63, 24.
अर्ध- + चन्द्र अर्ध- + चन्द्र, see separately.
अर्धभाज् अर्धभाज्, i. e. अर्ध-भज्, adj. Getting a half of, Man. 8, 39.
अर्धभास्कर अर्ध भास्कर, m. Noon, Rām. 3, 55, 33 (अर्धचन्द्र-, loc. At noon on the day of the halfmoon, i. e. on the eighth day of the month).
अर्धरात्रार्धदिवस अर्धरात्रार्धदिवस, i. e. अर्ध-रात्र-अर्ध-दिवस, m. The equinox, Rām. 3, 55, 35.

अर्धिक अर्धिक, i. e. अर्ध + इक, adj., f. की, Amounting to the half, Yājñ. 2, 296.
 --Comp.
आर्धिक आर्धिक, (i. e. probably अर्ध + इक), m. A labourer in tillage, Man. 4, 253.
अर्धिन् अर्धिन्, i. e. अर्ध + इन्, adj., f. नी, Entitled to a half, Man. 8, 210.
अर्धोरुक अर्धोरुक, i. e. अर्ध-ऊरु + क, n. A petticoat, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 9.
अर्ध- + अवशेष अर्ध- + अवशेष, adj. of which a half is left, Rām. 5, 14, 49.
अर्ध- + आसन अर्ध- + आसन, n. half a seat, Śāk. 97, 10.
अर्ध- + तनु अर्ध- + तनु, f. half a body.
अर्ध- + त्रयोदशन् अर्ध- + त्रयोदशन्, Thirteen and a half, Yājñ. 2, 165.
अर्ध- + दिवस अर्ध- + दिवस, m. noon, Rām. 1, 36, 6.
अर्ध- + पञ्चम अर्ध- + पञ्चम, adj. four and a half, Man. 4, 95.

अर्ध- + पण अर्ध- + पण, m. half a paṇa (see
 6), Man. 8, 404.
अर्ध- + पथिन् अर्ध- + पथिन्, m. the half of a way, Pañc. 134, 17.
अर्ध- + पादिक अर्ध- + पादिक, adj. Consisting in the loss of half of one foot, 8, 325.
अर्ध- + भाग अर्ध- + भाग, m. 1. half, Kumāras. 5, 50. 2. a part, Ragh. 7, 42.
अर्ध- + मार्ग अर्ध- + मार्ग, m. mid-way, Vikr. d. 3.
अर्ध- + मास अर्ध- + मास, m. half a month, a fortnight, Man. 4, 25.
अर्ध-इन्दु- + मौलि अर्ध-इन्दु- + मौलि, adj. epithet of Śiva (wearing the crescent as diadem), Megh. 56.
अर्ध- + उक्त अर्ध- + उक्त, adj. half uttered; ˚तेन, instr. without finishing one's speech, Vikr. 29, 19.
अर्ध- + शत अर्ध- + शत, n. a hundred and fifty, Man. 8, 331.
अर्ध- + सीरिन् अर्ध- + सीरिन्, i. e. अर्धसीर + इन्, m. A cultivator who takes half the crop for his labour, Yājñ. 1, 166.
